name: delegate-to-hub
description: Files a DELEGATION TICKET from a spoke project to its domain hub (co-develop, co-design, co-security) when the spoke PM faces a hard problem in the hub's domain. Enforces hub pre-checks, the lifecycle UNAVAILABLE gate (hub state file), the security-domain authorization gate (AUTH-YYYY-NNN registry row), safe ticket-content rules, and kanban alias / priority-governance semantics at filing time.
